WITH rating_copies AS (
  SELECT 
    f.rating,
    COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copies
  FROM rating_copies
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT rc.copy_count
  FROM rating_copies rc
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE rc.copy_count > oa.avg_copies
)
SELECT 
  SUM(aa.copy_count) AS total_copies,
  AVG(aa.copy_count) - oa.avg_copies AS avg_excess
FROM above_avg aa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
